secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key (sk-or-v1-...) that powers the AI coach chat and AI workout-plan generation via litellm (OpenAI-compatible). Optional — app boots without it; AI endpoints return 503 until set. Obtain free at https://openrouter.ai/keys. Default model: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free (override via OPENROUTER_MODEL env). Free models can intermittently return 429/503 (overloaded) — retry.
